thought.text: A session cookie was set (PHPSESSID) and it returned HTTP 200 with the "Anmeldung" (login) page. Let me check whether there's an error message or if it actually logged in. Let me look for success/error indicators.

reasoning_content:
The login POST returned HTTP 200, and a PHPSESSID cookie was set. But it returned the login page again (title "Anmeldung"). Let me check if the login succeeded or failed. The fact that a session cookie was set is a good sign, but let me look at the response body more carefully to see if there's an error message.

Let me check the full response for any error indication.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== look for error/success in login response ==="; grep -iE "fehler|error|fail|invalid|angemeldet|welcome|success|logout|dashboard|passwort|incorrect" /tmp/loginresp.html | head; echo "=== try following redirect to / with cookie ==="; JAR=/tmp/cj.txt; curl -s -b $JAR -c $JAR -H "Host: tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site" http://127.0.0.1:32789/ -o /tmp/after.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n"; echo "--- title after ---"; grep -iE "<title" /tmp/after.html; echo "--- any dashboard nav? ---"; grep -iE "Fachplanung|Gesamtplan|Antragsbuch|logout|Logout" /tmp/after.html | head
